prompts.Intent: Use case: ads-marketing / premium software portfolio poster. Generate ONE wide 16:9 image for IntentSeal, an agent-security gateway. This must have an independent distinctive visual identity, NOT a pale Veriscope-style centered headline above a dashboard. Art direction: midnight ink-black and deep aubergine, precise electric iris/violet light with restrained coral for blocked actions, bold modern grotesk typography, technical magazine cover meets premium security product launch. ASYMMETRIC composition: large left-aligned brand 'IntentSeal' top-left and enormous stacked headline 'Intent in.\nThreats out.' left third. Beneath in readable small text: 'Inspect inputs. Gate actions. Keep the proof.' On right two-thirds, an architectural isometric cutaway of a thin translucent violet SECURITY GATE: incoming document cards and input traces pass through a central luminous aperture; hostile red instructions stop at the barrier, legitimate violet paths continue to approved tool calls. Integrate TWO crisp floating dark product UI panels, not a whole generic browser dashboard: one 'Action checkpoint' with 'web_search · Allowed' and 'send_email · Blocked', another 'Decision receipt' with 'Rule / Reason / Source' and 'Session replay'. At bottom a very minimal horizontal pipeline 'Untrusted input → Inspection → Action gate → Evidence'. Small 'Illustrative session' label. Sophisticated controlled 3D materials, realistic glass edges, fine technical grid, generous negative space, sharply legible type, designed for attractive thumbnail recognition. Truth: IntentSeal neutralises malicious spans, enforces deterministic tool policy and records replayable evidence; do not claim total security or invent benchmarks. No numbers, fake metrics or customer logos. No giant generic shield, no padlock stock art, no serif typography, no centered ivory layout, no green palette, no paper board. Full bleeding dark composition without white border. Return generated image.
